```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
library(UpSetR)
library(grid)

# ID format for suppa: "ENSG00000000419.12;SE:chr20:50940933-50941129:50941209-50942031:-"
average_read_coverage <- 20
min_average_PSI <- .05
max_average_PSI <- 1 - min_average_PSI
min_read_coverage <- 10
min_samples_coverage <- 3
suppa_dir <- file.path("suppa_analysis", "events_rmats")
dir.create(suppa_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

rmats_dir <- "rmats_out"
event_type <- "MXE"
junction_counts <- "MATS.JC.txt"
plot_dist <- TRUE

for (event_type in c("SE", "RI", "A3SS", "A5SS", "MXE")) {
  for (rmats_dir in c( # "rmats_out_all", "rmats_out_2",
    "rmats_out" # , "rmats_out_3"
  )) {
    for (junction_counts in c(
      "MATS.JC.txt" # , "MATS.JCEC.txt"
    )) {
      junction_file <- file.path(rmats_dir, paste(event_type, junction_counts, sep = "."))
      event_type <- substr(event_type, 1, 2)
      # read file with counts
      dt <-
        fread(junction_file)
      if (event_type == "SE") {
        dt[, suppa_id := sprintf(
          "%s;%s:%s:%s-%s:%s-%s:%s",
          GeneID,
          event_type,
          chr,
          upstreamEE,
          exonStart_0base + 1,
          exonEnd,
          downstreamES + 1,
          strand
        )]
      } else if (event_type == "RI") {
        dt[, suppa_id := sprintf(
          "%s;%s:%s:%s:%s-%s:%s:%s",
          GeneID,
          event_type,
          chr,
          upstreamES + 1,
          upstreamEE,
          downstreamES + 1,
          downstreamEE,
          strand
        )]
      } else if (event_type == "A3") {
        dt[, suppa_id := sprintf(
          "%s;%s:%s:%s-%s:%s-%s:%s",
          GeneID,
          event_type,
          chr,
          ifelse(strand == "+", flankingEE, longExonEnd),
          ifelse(strand == "+", longExonStart_0base + 1, flankingES + 1),
          ifelse(strand == "+", flankingEE, shortEE),
          ifelse(strand == "+", shortES + 1, flankingES + 1),
          strand
        )]
      } else if (event_type == "A5") {
        dt[, suppa_id := sprintf(
          "%s;%s:%s:%s-%s:%s-%s:%s",
          GeneID,
          event_type,
          chr,
          ifelse(strand == "+", longExonEnd, flankingEE),
          ifelse(strand == "+", flankingES + 1, longExonStart_0base + 1),
          ifelse(strand == "+", shortEE, flankingEE),
          ifelse(strand == "+", flankingES + 1, shortES + 1),
          strand
        )]
      } else if (event_type == "MX") {
        dt[, suppa_id := sprintf(
          "%s;%s:%s:%s-%s:%s-%s:%s-%s:%s-%s:%s",
          GeneID,
          event_type,
          chr,
          upstreamEE,
          `1stExonStart_0base` + 1,
          `1stExonEnd`,
          downstreamES + 1,
          upstreamEE,
          `2ndExonStart_0base` + 1,
          `2ndExonEnd`,
          downstreamES + 1,
          strand
        )]
      } else {
        stop("Not implemented yet")
      }

      # convert to long format
      id_vars <-
        c(
          "ID",
          "geneSymbol",
          "suppa_id"
        )

      long_dt <-
        melt(
          dt,
          id.vars = id_vars,
          measure.vars = c("IJC_SAMPLE_1", "SJC_SAMPLE_1", "IncLevel1")
        )
      # add sample names, by splitting by comma and retaining the order of which they appear in the rmats input file
      long_dt[, bam_dt[, sample_name] := tstrsplit(value, ",", fixed = TRUE, type.convert = TRUE)]
      # convert to even longer format to have one row per sample
      long_long_dt <-
        melt(
          long_dt,
          id.vars = c(id_vars, "variable"),
          measure.vars = bam_dt[, sample_name],
          variable.name = "sample_name"
        )
      # add experiment type
      long_long_dt[, experiment_type := tstrsplit(sample_name, "_", keep = 2)]
      # create suppa id
      long_long_dt[, ]
      # compute average counts per event and per experiment type and event
      average_count_dt <-
        rbind(long_long_dt[variable %in% c("IJC_SAMPLE_1", "SJC_SAMPLE_1"), .(average_count = mean(value) * 2), by = .(ID)],
          long_long_dt[variable %in% c("IJC_SAMPLE_1", "SJC_SAMPLE_1"), .(average_count = mean(value) * 2), by = .(experiment_type, ID)],
          fill = TRUE
        )
      # Compute average PSI per event and per experiment type and event
      average_psi_dt <-
        rbind(
          long_long_dt[variable %in% c("IncLevel1"), .(average_psi = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE)),
            by =
              .(ID)
          ],
          long_long_dt[variable %in% c("IncLevel1"), .(average_psi = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE)),
            by =
              .(experiment_type, ID)
          ],
          fill = TRUE
        )
      average_dt <- merge(average_psi_dt, average_count_dt)
      # plot average count and PSI distributions
      if (plot_dist) {
        print(
          ggplot(
            average_count_dt,
            aes(x = average_count + 1, color = experiment_type)
          ) +
            geom_line(aes(y = 1 - after_stat(y)), stat = "ecdf") +
            scale_x_log10() +
            geom_vline(xintercept = average_read_coverage + 1) +
            labs(title = sprintf("Average Read Coverage: %s with line at %d", junction_file, average_read_coverage + 1))
        )
        print(
          ggplot(average_psi_dt, aes(x = average_psi, fill = experiment_type)) +
            geom_histogram(position = "dodge") +
            geom_vline(xintercept = c(min_average_PSI, max_average_PSI)) +
            labs(title = sprintf("Average PSI: %s", junction_file))
        )
        print(
          ggplot(
            average_psi_dt[average_psi >= min_average_PSI &
              average_psi <= max_average_PSI],
            aes(x = average_psi, fill = experiment_type)
          ) +
            geom_histogram(position = "dodge", binwidth = .05) +
            geom_vline(xintercept = c(min_average_PSI, max_average_PSI)) +
            labs(title = sprintf("Average PSI: %s, %f <= PSI < %f", junction_file, min_average_PSI, max_average_PSI))
        )
        ### Check per-sample read coverage filtering ----
        # Step 1: Compute total counts per event/sample
        event_sample_counts <- long_long_dt[
          variable %in% c("IJC_SAMPLE_1", "SJC_SAMPLE_1"),
          .(total_count = sum(value)),
          by = .(ID, sample_name)
        ]

        # Step 2: Create grid of thresholds to test
        min_read_cutoffs <- c(0, 1, 5, 10, 15, 20)
        min_sample_cutoffs <- c(1, 3, 5, 10)

        # Step 3: Expand combinations and compute how many events pass
        plot_dt <- CJ(
          min_read_coverage = min_read_cutoffs,
          min_samples_coverage = min_sample_cutoffs
        )

        plot_dt[, n_pass := event_sample_counts[
          total_count >= min_read_coverage,
          .N,
          by = ID
        ][N >= min_samples_coverage, .N],
        by = .(min_read_coverage, min_samples_coverage)
        ]

        print(ggplot(plot_dt, aes(
          x = min_samples_coverage, y = n_pass,
          color = factor(min_read_coverage)
        )) +
          geom_line() +
          geom_point() +
          labs(
            title = junction_file,
            x = "Minimum number of samples with sufficient read count",
            y = "Number of events (ID) retained",
            color = "Min per-sample read count"
          ))

        ###  Check average read coverages and PSI filtering ----

        # Step 1: Create grid of thresholds to test
        min_PSI_cutoffs <- seq(0, 0.05, by = 0.01)

        plot_dt <- CJ(
          average_read_coverage = min_read_cutoffs,
          min_average_PSI = min_PSI_cutoffs
        )



        plot_dt[, n_pass := average_dt[
          !is.na(experiment_type) &
            average_count >= average_read_coverage &
            average_psi >= min_average_PSI &
            average_psi <= 1 - min_average_PSI,
          ID,
          by = experiment_type
        ][duplicated(ID), .N],
        by = .(average_read_coverage, min_average_PSI)
        ]

        print(ggplot(plot_dt, aes(
          x = min_average_PSI, y = n_pass,
          color = factor(average_read_coverage)
        )) +
          geom_line() +
          geom_point() +
          labs(
            title = sprintf("Min averages per experiment type: %s", junction_file),
            x = "Minimum average PSI",
            y = "Number of events (ID) retained",
            color = "Min average read coverage"
          ))
      }

      keep_ids_orig <-
        average_dt[
          !is.na(experiment_type) &
            average_count >= average_read_coverage &
            average_psi >= min_average_PSI &
            average_psi <= 1 - min_average_PSI,
          ID,
          by = experiment_type
        ][duplicated(ID), ID]
      # intersect(
      #   average_psi_dt[!is.na(experiment_type) &
      #     average_psi >= min_average_PSI &
      #     average_psi <= max_average_PSI, ID, by = experiment_type][duplicated(ID), ID],
      #   average_count_dt[!is.na(experiment_type) &
      #     average_count >= average_read_coverage, ID, by = experiment_type][duplicated(ID), ID]
      # )

      keep_ids_min_sample <- long_long_dt[variable %in% c("IJC_SAMPLE_1", "SJC_SAMPLE_1"), .(total_count = sum(value)), by = .(ID, sample_name)][total_count >= min_read_coverage, .N, by = ID][N >= min_samples_coverage, ID]

      upset <- upset(
        fromList(list(orig = keep_ids_orig, min_sample = keep_ids_min_sample)),
        nsets = 2,
        order.by = "freq",
        mainbar.y.label = "Number of events (ID)",
        sets.x.label = "Total events (ID)"
      )
      print(upset)
      grid.text(sprintf("%s", junction_file), x = 0.65, y = 0.95, gp = gpar(fontsize = 20))

      long_long_dt[bam_dt, on = .NATURAL, uuid := uuid]
      suppa_format_dt <- dcast(long_long_dt[ID %in% keep_ids_orig &
        variable == "IncLevel1"], suppa_id ~ uuid, value.var = "value")
      suppa_file <- file.path(suppa_dir, paste0("event_", event_type, ".psi"))
      write.table(as.data.frame(suppa_format_dt[, -"suppa_id"], row.names = suppa_format_dt[, suppa_id]), suppa_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)
      fwrite(unique(long_long_dt[, .(ID, geneSymbol, suppa_id)]), paste0(suppa_file, ".annot"))

      ### PCA ----
      # long_long_dt[average_psi_dt, on = .NATURAL, average_psi := average_psi]
      # long_long_dt[, imputed_value := value]
      # long_long_dt[is.na(imputed_value) &
      #   variable == "IncLevel1", imputed_value := average_psi]
      # for (keep_ids_name in c("orig", "min_sample")) {
      #   keep_ids <- get(paste0("keep_ids_", keep_ids_name))
      #   for (col in c("value", "imputed_value")) {
      #     event_mat <-
      #       as.matrix(
      #         dcast(long_long_dt[ID %in% keep_ids &
      #           variable == "IncLevel1"], sample_name ~ ID, value.var = col),
      #         rownames = "sample_name"
      #       )

      #     for (i in 1:ncol(event_mat)) {
      #       event_mat[is.na(event_mat[, i]), i] <-
      #         mean(event_mat[, i], na.rm = TRUE)
      #     }
      #     event_pca <- rsvd::rpca(event_mat, 4)
      #     rsvd::ggscreeplot(event_pca)
      #     variance <- event_pca$sdev^2
      #     explained_variance_ratio <- round(variance / event_pca$var, 3) * 100
      #     plot_dt <- as.data.table(event_pca$x, keep.rownames = "uuid")
      #     setnames(plot_dt, c("V1", "V2"), c("PC1", "PC2"))
      #     print(rsvd::ggindplot(
      #       event_pca,
      #       groups = unlist(tstrsplit(rownames(event_mat), "_", keep = 2)),
      #       ind_labels = FALSE
      #     ) + labs(title = paste(junction_file, keep_ids_name, col)))
      #     print(rsvd::ggindplot(
      #       event_pca,
      #       pcs = c(1, 3),
      #       groups = unlist(tstrsplit(rownames(event_mat), "_", keep = 2)),
      #       ind_labels = FALSE
      #     ) + labs(title = paste(junction_file, keep_ids_name, col)))
      #   }
    }
  }
}
```
